description: Get active business/financial goals and their progress. Use when user asks about their goals, targets, or how they are tracking against objectives.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

goal_type.description: Filter by type: revenue_target, expense_reduction, savings_target, profit_margin, cash_reserve, debt_reduction, client_acquisition, invoice_collection, custom

status.description: Filter by status: active, completed, all (default: active)

name: get_goals
title: Get Goals
